notable: LLC formation is $100 online; paper filing costs $20 more (https://sos.idaho.gov/business-forms/)
uncertain: All Idaho State Tax Commission, Legislature and Department of Labor servers (tax.idaho.gov, legislature.idaho.gov, labor.idaho.gov, gov.idaho.gov) refused or timed out connections from this environment all day; only sos.idaho.gov was reachable. Income tax, S corp/PTET, estimated tax and SUTA were left null.

Search excerpts (not read on the official page) indicate: flat 5.3% individual rate effective Jan 1, 2025 (Idaho Code 63-3024, HB 40 of 2025) applied above a zero-rate amount, the federal standard deduction used as Idaho's, and a 2026 bill H0589 amending 63-3024 for tax years from 2027 whose effect was not confirmed. Verify before use.
Annual report: Idaho LLC annual reports are believed to have no fee and be due by the end of the anniversary month - not stated on any sos.idaho.gov page read today.
Idaho PTET (elective, at the corporate/individual rate) exists per general knowledge but was not verified; recorded as null.
S corp 'recognized: yes' is general knowledge, not read on an official page today.
